claims.statement: Heterogeneous EEG formats and metadata create a real interoperability and reproducibility problem that EEG-BIDS was designed to address.
Free MNE-BIDS, EEG-BIDS and the local browser validator already cover substantial conversion and validation functionality.
Manual study knowledge remains necessary for events, metadata, anonymisation and format decisions, leaving room for a bounded review and acceptance workflow.
A vendor can give away BIDS conversion for its own device format, so a device-mapping library alone is not a defensible paid control point.
Guided BIDS mapping, human revision, QA and validation are reproducible in open source; differentiation must come from accepted audit evidence, support and repeated edge-case resolution.
Polish research grants can fund crucial software, development and outsourced research services, providing a possible budget route without proving demand.
An 8000-18000 PLN annual licence must save roughly one to two person-months against the NCN specialist-support remuneration benchmark to be conservatively compelling.
Clinical-trial audit trails and traceable transfers create a paid control point, but only for the regulated subset and only if the system and procedures meet the applicable validation expectations.
Local execution reduces transfers of sensitive data but does not remove GDPR legal-basis, safeguarding and governance obligations.
Commercial willingness to pay, renewal behaviour and the European count of recurrent EEG curation buyers are not established.
The cost of supporting each additional device format and the share of projects that become bespoke are not established.

contrary_evidence: A mature free ecosystem already converts, validates and imports or exports EEG-BIDS.
A major equipment vendor provides its own free BIDS converter.
Guided mapping and QA are reproducible in open-source tooling.
Academic budget eligibility is not evidence of procurement or renewal.
The strongest audit-trail control point applies to a narrower regulated subset than the whole proposed customer base.
